lede: The biggest item this week is the San Miguel County BOCC's special meeting Tuesday, where they'll consider changing the AMI limits on deed-restricted properties in Pinion Park — a technical-sounding vote that determines who actually qualifies for affordable housing. Also Tuesday, the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy. Over in Ridgway, the Town Council is ratifying letters supporting a federal disaster declaration tied to the Gold Mountain Fire, which has scorched nearly 40,000 acres and repeatedly cut off Highway 550.

notable.stake: Council ratifies disaster declaration support for Gold Mountain Fire recovery.
